title: Working on a dark sci-fi horror icon set — what's usually missing in your projects?
author: VortexAssetStudio
selftext:
Hey devs,

I'm putting together a realistic 2D sci-fi/survival horror pack and trying to figure out what to prioritize for the rest of the batch before I finalize it. Right now I've got a mix of infected space crew portraits, mutated horrors, and some alien egg variants (testing how clean the cutouts read at smaller UI sizes).If you're working on something in this genre, what usually slows you down or leaves gaps in your UI/encounters? I'm torn between focusing the next batch on:

More crew variants (medics, engineers, security with cracked visors, etc.)

Bigger boss-tier biomechanical creatures

Matching inventory loot (tissue samples, specimen jars, broken gear, canisters)

Any feedback on what would actually be useful in a real project is super appreciated
